svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 08 · San Diego · 01/12 Geisel Library (Legendary)
svg.desc: Concrete and glass stacked wide at the top, up in the eucalyptus. The lights stay on late for finals. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
